title: Personal Hive
description: Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
smart_description: Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
notes: This is a debilitating power applied to an enemy. Each time the enemy is hit by an Attack, Dazed cards are added to the player's Draw Pile. The number of Dazed cards added equals the counter value (stack amount) of Personal Hive.
